verdict.rationale: The product holds no data of its own. Its installer writes skills into your repo as ordinary, editable files you own (docs-24, docs-47), and a hands-on probe confirmed a plain SKILL.md landing in ./.claude/skills/ (probe-rt-1). The set is MIT-licensed, works with any agent or model, keeps issues in local markdown if you choose, and keeps ADRs and CONTEXT.md in the repo (docs-42, gh-12, docs-57, gh-2, gh-5), so leaving amounts to keeping your files. Missing for 10: no explicit export or offboarding documentation; the plugin route is a managed read-only bundle rather than owned files (docs-41); artifacts stored in GitHub or Linear issue trackers depend on those services' own export; no independent corroboration of a clean exit.
